# Wausau Tile

> > Wausau Tile manufactures architectural precast concrete pavers, terrazzo, and site furnishings for commercial projects across America.

Wausau Tile specializes in American-made architectural products including the Terra System One, Urbastyle Collection, Quattro Series Pavers, and Hidden Lok-Down System. Their installations are featured in iconic locations like Times Square, Guggenheim Museum, and Christian Science Plaza in Boston.

## Key Topics

- Precast concrete pavers
- Terrazzo products
- Terra System One
- Urbastyle Collection
- Hidden Lok-Down System
- Quattro Series Pavers
- Architectural site furnishings
- American manufacturing
- Wind uplift resistance

- Outdoor furniture
- Installation systems
- Tile products
- Project gallery
